_scenario: DST spring-forward (2026-03-08 — US Eastern jumps from 02:00 to 03:00 local)
_note: Humanity returns UTC `Z`-suffixed timestamps regardless of operator timezone (per field_mapping.md). The 2026-03-08 spring-forward in US Eastern means 02:30 ET does not exist locally; UTC values that translate to non-existent local times must still business-date correctly via iana_timezone_converter.toBusinessDate. Three shifts span the transition window: one ends just before, one straddles the gap, one starts just after.

data._local_window_note: America/New_York: 17:00 EST -> 02:00 EST (last instant before clock jumps to 03:00 EDT)
America/New_York: 00:00 EST -> 09:00 EDT (in_time before transition; out_time after; 1 hour 'lost' in local-clock terms but UTC duration = 8h)
America/New_York: 03:30 EDT -> 11:30 EDT (entirely after the DST transition)
